title: Search, SEO and agents: agent skills for TYPO3
header: Search, SEO and agents in 96 seconds
description: Be found by Google, by your own site search and by AI agents, with every statement in the markup taken from the visible page. For each skill: the prompt you would type and what it does. Narrated, with selectable captions.
alt: Film, 96 seconds: Search, SEO and agents, 4 agent skills for TYPO3 v14 (typo3-seo, typo3-structured-data, typo3-solr, typo3-webmcp). Each skill with its own prompt and what it delivers. Narrated, with selectable captions.

transcript.text: A site now has to be found three ways: by search engines, by its own search and by AI agents.
Search, SEO and agents: four skills for TYPO3 v14.
Sitemaps, canonical URLs, hreflang, meta tags, Open Graph and robots rules with EXT:seo.
It starts where the symptoms show: language versions mixed up in Google, or a sitemap with only the home page in it.
Builds schema.org JSON-LD from the records that render the page, and keeps it through an upgrade.
The validator finds no errors. The graph says what the page shows.
Runs and debugs Apache Solr search: indexing, facets, suggest, PDFs and stuck queues.
A Solr server that accepts documents can still drop unknown fields.
Makes search, navigation and forms usable as typed WebMCP tools for browser agents.
An agent fills the form. The consent box stays empty; a person sends it.
Open source. Clone the skills, and help us improve them.
